title: Hub configuration: channels, routing rules, inbound sinks

schema.description: telefi.* is current; notifly.* is accepted while producers migrate

mode.description: mock: every channel is replaced by the mock adapter (records, never sends)

spool.description: spool root, relative to TELEFI_HOME unless absolute; default 'spool' (env TELEFI_SPOOL overrides)

path.description: file channel: relative to TELEFI_HOME unless absolute

routes.description: first match wins; match keys are lists (any-of); an empty match is the default

delivery.description: now (default) or batch: hold Telegram delivery for the next batch window. critical and blocker ignore it (always now).

enabled.description: read replies (long-poll getUpdates); keep false while another process polls the same bot

argv.description: command sink: argv; the inbound JSON arrives on stdin

commands.description: hub-owned command word -> namespace, e.g. retry -> ci. Any other /command and any button not made by the hub goes to the 'legacy' sink with the raw update.

ack_days.description: an acked dedup_key is not re-delivered for this many days

manifests.description: paths of commands.v1 manifests, one per app; /help, /list and /<app> <verb> routing come from them

digest.description: batch windows: envelopes held by delivery=batch leave as ONE silent Telegram message per window

at.description: old form of a single window (HH:MM). Ignored when windows is set

timezone.description: IANA zone name for `at`; default: the machine's local zone

windows.description: HH:MM, 24 h, local to timezone; one batch message per window (default 08:00, 12:00, 16:00, 20:00)

quiet.description: [start, end] quiet hours (exactly two HH:MM): only critical goes out, a blocker waits for the end (default ["22:00", "07:00"]); [] switches them off

days.description: weekdays the windows run on; unset means every day

rollup.description: send counts per source, merge repeated runs, and lead with what needs the owner

research_sources.description: sources whose results form the Research section of a batch (default research)

logs.description: rotation of the jsonl records and hub.log

max_bytes.description: a log is full at this size (default 10 MB)

rotate_at.description: rotate at this fraction of max_bytes, the safety margin (default 0.9)
